fields.comment: KidsFirst; The MP term definition for chordee MP:0003555 specifies acute angulation of the penis upon erection and places chordee under abnormal penile erection MP:0001379, unlike HPO which places Chordee HP:0000041 under Abnormal penis morphology HP:0000036 and provides details on the direction of bowing and degree of angulation. I think the match is therefore close and the MP term should be placed under both abnormal penile erection and morphology (see https://educalingo.com/en/dic-en/chordee)

effectiveMetadata.mapping_set_description: Consolidated list of all HPO to MP mappings done by MGI. In the comments section the project that was the source of the list is listed. Some terms came from more than one source. The KidsFirst list was a list of HPO terms provided by the KidsFirst team from the set of terms used for patients in their cohorts. The scoliosis, Alzheimer, cleft palate, Down Syndrome, CHARGE Syndrome, Cornelia De Lange Syndrome, and COVID term sets were generated by MGI for symptoms or phenotypes associated with the disease. For the COVID set the references for each sign or symptom are listed in the Other column. Initially the mapping dates for the KidsFirst mappings were not tracked, so these were given the date of when we received the file (5/27/21).  The scoliosis, cleft palate, Down Syndrome, CHARGE Syndrome, and Cornelia De Lange Syndrome sets consist of MP terms that are associated with mouse models of scoliosis. For Down Syndrome, CHARGE Syndrome, and Cornelia De Lange Syndrome HPO terms associated with each disease were also pulled from the HPO files for mapping. The Alzheimer and COVID sets were created by identifying symptoms and signs for patients from the literature then identifying the relevant MP and HP terms and finally mapping the identified terms to terms in the other ontology. Use of skos mappings terms: exact match: MP term is the same as the HPO term, ignoring that the HP term applies only to humans; broad match: HPO term covers more than the MP term, ignoring the species restriction; narrow match: HPO term is more restricted than the MP term; related match: MP term and HPO term share some similarity but would not have a parent-child relation in a shared ontology.

packs.description: Bounded binary SKOS mapping profile: symmetric exact/close/related; transitive exact; broad/narrow inverse; exact disjoint with broad/narrow/related; exact is a subproperty of close. Closed explicit laws preserve unknown uncertainty and lossiness, infer no authority or OWL identity, and omit pragmatic non-SKOS chains. Normative source: https://www.w3.org/TR/skos-reference/#mapping
Minimal structural relations shared by language and domain adapters.
